name: SOS Meals on Wheels
description: SOS Meals on Wheels delivers nutritious meals to about 3,000 older adults in Oakland, Hayward, San Leandro, Castro Valley, San Lorenzo, Fremont, Newark, and Union City, along with wellness checks and friendly visits. It has served Alameda County for 60 years.
fullDescription: SOS Meals on Wheels delivers nutritious meals to about 3,000 older adults in Oakland, Hayward, San Leandro, Castro Valley, San Lorenzo, Fremont, Newark, and Union City, along with wellness checks and friendly visits. It has served Alameda County for 60 years.
whatTheyOffer:
- Nutritionally balanced meals delivered Monday-Friday
- Wellness checks and friendly visits from trained drivers
- Referrals to other services that help seniors stay at home
- Suggested donation of $4 per meal, but no senior is turned away
howToGetIt: Call 510-582-1263 (ext. 118 for Oakland, San Leandro, Hayward, Castro Valley, San Lorenzo; ext. 156 for Fremont, Newark, Union City) or fill out the Client Interest Form online. You must be 60+, unable to shop for or prepare meals, and without a reliable caregiver. Intake screening is done by phone.
keywords: SOS Meals on Wheels, Oakland, Hayward, San Leandro, Castro Valley, San Lorenzo, Fremont, Newark, Union City, home delivered meals, senior meals, homebound
